messages.text: Reminder: We have switched our default AI embedding provider to Gemini Embedding 2. Vector dimension is 3072. All vector collections must be updated.

replies.text: Does this impact the Qdrant local cluster?
Yes, re-indexing is required. Hybrid search now pairs Gemini 3072-dim vectors with BM25 Okapi.

messages.text: WiFi and VPN update: The new internal corporate VPN is WireGuard-based at vpn.corp.internal:51820. Legacy OpenVPN will be retired on Sept 1st.
Expense Policy update: Employee learning & development stipend is $1,500/year, claimable via Concur with receipts.

replies.text: Can we use this for AI API credits and certifications?
Yes, technical books, certifications, and AI API credits are fully eligible.
